knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Unknown status is recorded and referred. Age and odour do not show that the area is safe.
Dry-sweeping can create dust and aerosols. The other two options are part of a safe process.

practicalCriteria: From a fictional site report, the learner lists at least three exposure routes and marks the uncertain areas. Pass: three routes and at least one uncertain area are named.
For each route, the learner names an assessor and an escalation owner. Pass: no route is left without an owner.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed hazard inventory for a fictional site
stopWorkCriteria: The hazard is unknown or concealed.
A task would produce aerosols or dust without an approved method.
